reconstruction_notes.en: A small horsetail-form concept appropriate to a stylized Mesozoic wet margin. It is not bamboo or a Carboniferous Calamites tree. Size, density, branch count, cones and colors are simplified artistic choices, not a fossil-locality reconstruction.

sources.use: True tracks are depressions in a substrate.

sources.title: NPS: Dinosaurs in the Fossil Record
sources.use: Tracks are trace evidence and do not automatically identify a genus.

design_notes: Each footprint is a geometric cavity 46 mm below its local substrate, with an 8 mm raised lip.
The long middle digit, shorter diverging side digits, and alternating lateral offset establish a clear travel direction.
Depth, step length, toe proportions, and wet/dry color are illustrative. They must not be used to infer a species, speed, or body mass.
